# Center for a New American Security (CNAS)

> > CNAS is a bipartisan national security think tank providing expert analysis on defense policy, geopolitical competition, emerging military technologies, and transatlantic security challenges.

The Center for a New American Security produces research, podcasts, and commentary on critical security issues including U.S.-China tech competition, drone warfare, Middle East conflicts, NATO alliances, and defense innovation. CNAS experts like Becca Wasser, Andrea Kendall-Taylor, and Jim Townsend regularly contribute to policy debates on great-power competition and military modernization.

## Key Topics

- Transatlantic security and NATO
- U.S.-China strategic competition
- Drone warfare and military technology
- Middle East security and Iran conflict
- Ukraine-Russia conflict
- Indo-Pacific security
- Defense policy and military AI
- Economic sanctions and export controls
- Nuclear proliferation
- Korean Peninsula security
- Military innovation and adaptation
- Maritime supply chain security
- Trump administration foreign policy
- Great-power competition
- Regional security dynamics

## Geopolitical Competition and Strategic Analysis

- [U.S.-China Competition Accelerates Across the Tech Stack](https://www.cnas.org/publications/commentary/u-s-china-competition-accelerates-across-the-tech-stack): Just Security analysis of US-China tech restrictions & export controls
- [Can China Capitalize on Changing Transatlantic Currents?](https://www.cnas.org/publications/podcast/can-china-capitalize-on-changing-transatlantic-currents): Brussels Sprouts on Munich Security Conference & China's transatlantic role
- [Trump's Way of War](https://www.cnas.org/publications/commentary/trumps-way-of-war): Foreign Affairs commentary on Trump's military strategy toward Iran
- [Are We Ready? | America's Next Battlefield, with Thomas Shugart](https://www.cnas.org/publications/podcast/are-we-ready-americas-next-battlefield-with-thomas-shugart): Thomas Shugart discusses military adaptation for great-power warfare
- [How Sanctions Became a Way to Wage War and When They Actually Work, with Eddie Fishman](https://www.cnas.org/publications/podcast/how-sanctions-became-a-way-to-wage-war-and-when-they-actually-work-with-eddie-fishmane): Eddie Fishman on financial sanctions as economic warfare tool

## Middle East Security and Iran

- [The Israeli-Iranian War: How We Got Here & What It Means](https://www.cnas.org/publications/podcast/the-israeli-iranian-war-how-we-got-here-what-it-means): Podcast with Nicole Grajewski on Israel-Iran conflict & regional security
- [Rising Lion Shows the U.S. Needs More Allies Like Israel](https://www.cnas.org/publications/commentary/rising-lion-shows-the-u-s-needs-more-allies-like-israel): Commentary on Operation Rising Lion & US-Israel alliance against Iran

## Drone Warfare and Military Technology

- [Drones: Who Is Making the New Weapons of War?](https://www.cnas.org/publications/podcast/drones-who-is-making-the-new-weapons-of-war): BBC podcast with CNAS experts on drone warfare & defense industry trends
- [Who Will Lead on Military AI, the Government or Industry?](https://www.cnas.org/publications/video/who-will-lead-on-military-ai-the-government-or-industry): Breaking Defense video on military AI leadership & defense technology
- [Ukrainians Build Low-Tech Defense Against Russian Drones](https://www.cnas.org/publications/video/ukrainians-build-low-tech-defense-against-russian-drones): Samuel Bendett analyzes Ukraine's low-tech drone countermeasures

## Transatlantic Security and NATO

- [Transatlantic Tumult at Davos](https://www.cnas.org/publications/podcast/transatlantic-tumult): Brussels Sprouts podcast on NATO crisis & Trump's Greenland dispute
- [Ex-NATO Official: Putin Is 'Stringing Along Trump' to Push for Sanctions Relief](https://www.cnas.org/publications/video/ex-nato-official-putin-is-stringing-along-trump-to-push-for-sanctions-relief): Jim Townsend analyzes Putin-Trump diplomacy & Ukraine peace negotiations
- [Canada and Carney's New American Approach](https://www.cnas.org/publications/podcast/canada-and-carneys-new-american-approach): Podcast on Mark Carney's Liberal Party & Canada-US relations under Trump

## Nuclear Security and Proliferation

- [Why We Should Worry About Nuclear Weapons Again](https://www.cnas.org/publications/commentary/why-we-should-worry-about-nuclear-weapons-again): Washington Post commentary on nuclear proliferation & Cold War threats
- [North Korea Hardens Posture as Allies Recalibrate Before APEC](https://www.cnas.org/publications/video/n-korea-hardens-posture-as-allies-recalibrate-before-apec): Video on North Korea diplomacy & denuclearization before APEC summit
- [Trade Frictions Ramp Up; Ukraine Drones Strike Russia | Bloomberg: The Asia Trade](https://www.cnas.org/publications/video/trade-frictions-ramp-up-ukraine-drones-strike-russia-bloomberg-the-asia-trade): Duyeon Kim on Bloomberg discusses Asia trade & Ukraine-Russia conflict

## Optional

- [An Overlooked National Security Challenge: Maritime Supply Chain Security](https://www.cnas.org/publications/commentary/an-overlooked-national-security-challenge-maritime-supply-chain-security): Pathfinder essay on maritime vulnerabilities & global trade security
- [Protecting the Integrity of the National Guard](https://www.cnas.org/publications/commentary/protecting-the-integrity-of-the-national-guard): Claire Finkelstein on Posse Comitatus & National Guard federalization
- ['Drill, Baby, Drill' Everywhere Except the U.S.](https://www.cnas.org/publications/video/drill-baby-drill-everywhere-except-the-u-s): Rachel Ziemba on Bloomberg discusses oil markets & global security policy
- [Colombian Family Files Legal Complaint on U.S. Strikes in Caribbean](https://www.cnas.org/publications/video/colombian-family-files-legal-complaint-on-u-s-strikes-in-caribbean): Carrie Cordero on CNN discusses US military strikes legal complaint
